netdryrun.prove.variants.x__customer_lea.reason: `not sizes[n][0]` -> `not sizes[n][1]`: an entry with an empty description always has no range (1 and 2 by default), and an entry with a description and no range (an inner leak) is only ever replaced by an identical one or by an outer leak, which the third clause admits either way
netdryrun.prove.variants.x__customer_lea.argument: Entries are (description, range). The defaults 1 and 2 are ("", None); an inner leak writes (non-empty, None); an outer leak writes (non-empty, tuple). A ("", tuple) entry never exists. So `not sizes[n][0]` and `not sizes[n][1]` differ only on (non-empty, None), an inner. There, a new inner writes the same description and None (no change); a new outer is admitted by the third clause in both versions.
